```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

source("Habitat.R")
source("Functions.R")
source("SimulationLoop.R")
source("ScenarioDefs.R")   # defines `scenarios` and `base_params`

load("data/wt.growth.array.pval.sthd.RData")  # loads `wt.growth`
```

## Cap test

**Purpose:** Test whether the cold-habitat bottleneck on recruitment and abundance is partly an artifact of very high mid-summer warm-patch temperatures (~25 °C, where growth is negative at any p). We cap warm-patch temperature at 19, 21 and 23 °C in the cold+warm scenario and compare against the existing baseline cold-only and cold+warm (uncapped) runs.

### Design

All runs use 25% cold habitat and the seed and parameters of `Baseline_ColdWarm_025percold_rep01`. The capped runs differ only in the warm-patch temperature ceiling and are shorter (20-yr burn-in + 20-yr experiment) than the baselines.

```{r}
cold_prop_key <- "025"   # change to e.g. "050" to test another cold proportion
warm_caps_C   <- c(19, 21, 22, 23)

short_len <- list(nyears_burnin = 20, nyears_experiment = 20)

base_coldwarm <- paste0("Baseline_ColdWarm_", cold_prop_key, "percold_rep01")
base_coldonly <- paste0("Baseline_ColdOnly_", cold_prop_key, "percold_rep01")
stopifnot(all(c(base_coldwarm, base_coldonly) %in% names(scenarios)))

run_defs <- tibble(
  cap           = warm_caps_C,
  run           = paste0("short_coldwarm_", cap, "C"),
  base_scenario = base_coldwarm
)
```

### Warm-patch temperature

```{r}
#| label: fig-temps
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

hab_ref <- build_habitat(modifyList(scenarios[[base_coldwarm]], short_len))
ref_year <- year(min(hab_ref$date)) + 1

cap_series <- map_dfr(warm_caps_C, \(cap) {
  hab_ref |>
    filter(year(date) == ref_year) |>
    transmute(date, series = paste0("Warm (cap ", cap, " °C)"),
              temp = pmin(temp_warm, cap))
})

bind_rows(
  hab_ref |> filter(year(date) == ref_year) |>
    transmute(date, series = "Cold", temp = temp_cold),
  hab_ref |> filter(year(date) == ref_year) |>
    transmute(date, series = "Warm (baseline)", temp = temp_warm),
  cap_series
) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, temp, color = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°C)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

### Run simulations

Results are cached to `results/` and skipped if the file exists. Delete the file or set `overwrite <- TRUE` to rerun. Burn-in rows are dropped from `ibm_long`.

```{r}
#| label: run-sims
overwrite <- FALSE

run_capped <- function(run, base_scenario, cap) {
  out_path <- file.path("results", paste0("WarmCap_", run, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(out_path) && !overwrite) {
    message("Skipping '", run, "' (results exist).")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  params <- modifyList(scenarios[[base_scenario]], short_len)
  params$save_burnin <- FALSE

  # Cap warm-patch temperature; the cold patch is untouched
  habitat_df <- build_habitat(params) |>
    mutate(temp_warm = pmin(temp_warm, cap))

  message("Running '", run, "' ...")
  t0  <- Sys.time()
  res <- run_simulation(habitat_df = habitat_df, params = params, wt_growth = wt.growth)
  attr(res, "run_time_secs") <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  saveRDS(res, out_path)
  invisible(NULL)
}

pwalk(run_defs, \(cap, run, base_scenario) run_capped(run, base_scenario, cap))
```

### Load results

Each file is reduced to what we need before binding, so the full `ibm_long` objects aren't held in memory together. Oct 1 census rows give abundance, biomass, recruitment and weight-at-age. Summer age-0 rows (Jun-Aug) give patch use.

```{r}
#| label: load-results

baseline_files <- tibble(
  run  = c("baseline_coldonly", "baseline_coldwarm"),
  path = file.path("results", paste0(c(base_coldonly, base_coldwarm), ".rds"))
)
capped_files <- run_defs |>
  transmute(run, path = file.path("results", paste0("WarmCap_", run, ".rds")))

all_files <- bind_rows(baseline_files, capped_files)

reduce_run <- function(run, path) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  ibm <- res$ibm_long

  # Experiment start: 20 yr for capped runs, baseline burn-in length otherwise
  nburn <- if (startsWith(run, "short")) short_len$nyears_burnin else base_params$nyears_burnin
  exp_start <- base_params$mindate + years(nburn)

  oct1 <- ibm |>
    filter(date >= exp_start, month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1, survived == 1) |>
    mutate(run = run, year = year(date), age_class = floor(age))

  summer_age0 <- ibm |>
    filter(date >= exp_start, month(date) %in% 6:8, survived == 1, floor(age) == 0) |>
    count(year = year(date), patch) |>
    mutate(run = run)

  list(oct1 = oct1, summer_age0 = summer_age0)
}

reduced <- pmap(all_files, reduce_run)

oct1        <- map_dfr(reduced, "oct1")
summer_age0 <- map_dfr(reduced, "summer_age0")
rm(reduced)

run_levels <- c("baseline_coldonly", "baseline_coldwarm", run_defs$run)
oct1        <- oct1        |> mutate(run = factor(run, levels = run_levels))
summer_age0 <- summer_age0 |> mutate(run = factor(run, levels = run_levels))
```

### Population abundance and biomass

Annual Oct 1 totals, summarized as the mean and SD across experimental years.

```{r}
pop_yr <- oct1 |>
  group_by(run, year) |>
  summarise(n = n(), biomass_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop")

pop_sum <- pop_yr |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(
    years  = n(),
    mean_n = mean(n),          sd_n = sd(n),
    mean_b = mean(biomass_kg), sd_b = sd(biomass_kg)
  )

pop_sum
```

### Recruitment (age-0 abundance on Oct 1)

Years with no age-0 survivors are counted as zero (census years are taken from any fish present on Oct 1 in that run).

```{r}
age0_yr <- oct1 |>
  distinct(run, year) |>
  left_join(
    oct1 |> filter(age_class == 0) |> count(run, year, name = "n_age0"),
    by = c("run", "year")
  ) |>
  replace_na(list(n_age0 = 0))

age0_yr |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(mean_age0 = mean(n_age0), sd_age0 = sd(n_age0), cv = sd_age0 / mean_age0)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-age0
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(age0_yr, aes(run, n_age0)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Age-0 abundance on Oct 1") +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

### Mean weight-at-age

```{r}
#| label: fig-waa
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

waa <- oct1 |>
  group_by(run, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight), sd_wt = sd(weight), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot(waa, aes(age_class, mean_wt, color = run)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Age class (years)", y = "Mean weight (g)", color = NULL) + theme_bw()
```

### Mechanism check: do age-0 fish use the warm patch in summer?

If the hypothesis is right, capped runs (especially the lower caps) should show a nontrivial share of age-0 fish in the warm patch in Jun-Aug, and the uncapped baseline should show about none. Shares are fish-days summed over Jun-Aug of each year.

```{r}
#| label: fig-warm-use
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

warm_share <- summer_age0 |>
  group_by(run, year) |>
  summarise(prop_warm = sum(n[patch == "warm"]) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")

warm_share |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(mean_prop_warm = mean(prop_warm), sd = sd(prop_warm))

ggplot(warm_share, aes(run, prop_warm)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of summer age-0\nfish-days in warm patch") +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

### Interpretation notes

- Compare each capped run to `baseline_coldwarm` for the effect of the cap, and to `baseline_coldonly` for whether warm habitat now helps relative to cold-only.
- Capped runs have a 20-yr burn-in versus 50 yr for the baselines. Check the time series for trends, which would indicate the capped runs have not equilibrated.
- With one seed per run, differences smaller than the interannual SD should not be over-interpreted. If a result is borderline, add replicates using the `sim_seed` values already in `ScenarioDefs.R`.

# Helper: read one scenario, extract ibm_long and spawn_log, and free res before returning
load_scen <- function(path, pc, ht, pcmax_cold, pcmax_warm) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  list(ibm_summary = res$ibm_summary, spawn_log = res$spawn_log,

# Helper: derive scen_key string from numeric prop_cold
pc_to_key <- function(pc) sprintf("%02d", round(pc * 100))

# Helper: extract Oct 1 experimental-period rows from one ibm_long
extract_oct1_exp <- function(ibm_summary, scen_key) {
  # if (ibm_is_empty(ibm_summary)) return(tibble())
  ibm_summary |>
    filter(date >= exp_start_date,
           month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    mutate(scen_key  = scen_key,
           year      = year(date)) |>
    group_by(scen_key, year) |>
    summarize(n_alive = sum(n_alive),
              biomass_kg = sum(biomass_g)/1000) |>
    ungroup()
}

# ── Oct 1 census: experimental period, all hab types, all scenarios ───────────
warm_max_levels <- c(25, 23, 22)
warm_max_labels <- paste0(warm_max_levels, " °C max")

# Baseline (25 C) runs plus capped runs; warm_max is NA for cold-only
exp_oct1_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(c(ibm_list_mech, ibm_list_cap), function(scen) {
  extract_oct1_exp(scen$ibm_summary, pc_to_key(scen$pc)) |>
    mutate(hab_type = scen$ht, warm_max = scen$warm_max %||% 25)
})

exp_oct1 <- bind_rows(
  exp_oct1_raw |> filter(hab_type != "Cold only"),
  # Cold-only has no warm patch, so reuse it in every warm-max panel
  exp_oct1_raw |> filter(hab_type == "Cold only") |>
    select(-warm_max) |>

  mutate(
    label    = factor(label,    levels = scen_meta$label),
    hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm", "Cold + Warm (high P)")),
    warm_max = factor(warm_max, levels = warm_max_levels, labels = warm_max_labels)
  )

# plotting function
ab_plot <- function(data, y_var, y_err, y_lab, title_str, y_limits) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = prop_cold, y = .data[[y_var]], color = hab_type)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, .data[[y_var]] - .data[[y_err]]), ymax = .data[[y_var]] + .data[[y_err]]), width = 0.05, linewidth = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.03)) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = hab_type, group = hab_type), linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.03)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = hab_type, fill = hab_type), size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black", position = position_dodge(width = 0.03)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Scenario") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = hab_cols, name = "Scenario") +
    # hab_scales +
    labs(y = y_lab, title = title_str) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(color = "black")) + 
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    facet_wrap(~warm_max, nrow = 1)
  p
}

### Weight-at-age


```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

# Pool patch-level summaries (patch x age class x year) into one mean and SD
# per age class, using the pooled-variance identity on group means and SDs.
extract_waa <- function(ibm_summary, pc) {
  ibm_summary |>
    filter(date >= exp_start_date, month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1, n_alive > 0) |>
    mutate(sd_weight = coalesce(sd_weight, 0),
           ssq = (n_alive - 1) * sd_weight^2 + n_alive * mean_weight^2) |>
    summarise(n = sum(n_alive), wsum = sum(n_alive * mean_weight), ssq = sum(ssq),
              .by = age_class) |>
    mutate(mean_wt = wsum / n,
           sd_wt   = sqrt(pmax(0, (ssq - n * mean_wt^2) / (n - 1))),
           prop_cold = pc) |>
    select(age_class, prop_cold, n, mean_wt, sd_wt)
}

waa_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(c(ibm_list_mech, ibm_list_cap), function(scen) {
  extract_waa(scen$ibm_summary, scen$pc) |>
    mutate(hab_type = scen$ht, warm_max = scen$warm_max %||% 25)
})

waa_scen <- bind_rows(
  waa_raw |> filter(hab_type != "Cold only"),
  waa_raw |> filter(hab_type == "Cold only") |>
    select(-warm_max) |>
    tidyr::crossing(warm_max = warm_max_levels)
) |>
  left_join(scen_meta |> select(label, prop_cold), by = "prop_cold") |>
  mutate(
    label    = factor(label, levels = scen_meta$label),
    hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = levels(exp_oct1$hab_type)),
    warm_max = factor(warm_max, levels = warm_max_levels, labels = warm_max_labels)
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5)

age_breaks_scen <- sort(unique(waa_scen$age_class))

ggplot(waa_scen, aes(x = age_class, y = mean_wt, color = label, fill = label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_wt - sd_wt), ymax = mean_wt + sd_wt),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scen_pal, name = "Cold habitat") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scen_pal, name = "Cold habitat") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = age_breaks_scen) +
  labs(
    x = "Age class (years)", y = "Mean weight (g)",
    title = "Mean weight-at-age by scenario (Oct 1, experimental period)",
    subtitle = "Ribbon = \u00b11 SD; pooled across patches and experimental years"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(hab_type ~ warm_max)
```
